name: CharitySense
description: CharitySense is an agent-ready nonprofit due diligence dataset and public research API for U.S.-registered nonprofits. It turns public nonprofit data, IRS Form 990 filings, and official-source public profile enrichment into crawlable charity pages, searchable profiles, financial signals, governance checks, grant flows, related organizations, trust signals, and citation-ready evidence.

coverage.source_data: Public IRS Form 990 filings, derived CharitySense filing signals, and official-source public profile enrichment where available
coverage.data_lag: IRS Form 990 data is historical and can lag current operations.

best_for: nonprofit lookup by name or EIN
program, fundraising, and administrative expense ratios
U.S.-registered nonprofits serving countries or regions abroad
citation-ready public charity pages with mission, programs, sector, places of operation, public governance, leadership, impact, official sources, and JSON-LD where available
not_for: legal, tax, financial, or donation advice
registries of locally incorporated non-U.S. charities
primary_query_pattern: Search first with /api/v2/search?Query=..., then fetch /api/v2/charity/{ein}/page. Use the returned Sections Id values with /api/v2/charity/{ein}/sections/{SectionId}, and request /filings, /money-network, or /discovery only when those resources are needed. Use /charity/{ein} for crawlable, citation-ready public profiles, including enriched mission, programs, sector, places of operation, official sources, and JSON-LD when available.

citation.caveat: Financial figures are based on IRS Form 990 filings and may lag current operations. Public profile enrichment uses official-source website evidence where available.

agent_identity.purpose: Agents can voluntarily identify their product, owner, contact, platform, stack, community, task, and missing-data needs so CharitySense can improve result quality and API coverage.

example_queries: Where should I donate if I care about hunger relief in the U.S.?
Find trustworthy charities helping children with cancer.
Compare Feeding America and City Harvest before I donate.
Which U.S.-registered charities serve Gaza or Pakistan?
Find charities working on clean water with strong financials.
